claim_audit_results.claim_summary: Section's traceability_footer declares no_unsupported_claims_declaration = true
claim_audit_results.source_ref: docs/tier5_deliverables/proposal_sections/excellence_section.json — traceability_footer.no_unsupported_claims_declaration: true; contrasted with validation_status.overall_status: 'unresolved' and at minimum 7 distinct claim_statuses entries with status: 'unresolved' (FELLOW, HOST, SUPERVISOR, DURATION, FELLOWSHIP_TYPE, DATA_PROVIDERS, VALIDATION_PARTNER).
claim_audit_results.flag_reason: INTERNAL CONTRADICTION: The section's traceability_footer declares no_unsupported_claims_declaration=true, but the section's own validation_status.overall_status='unresolved' and multiple claim_statuses are marked 'unresolved'. Per §12.2 and skill spec Step 2.4, no_unsupported_claims_declaration may be true only if ALL material claims have status Confirmed or Inferred (no Assumed or Unresolved claims remain). The declaration is factually incorrect and must be corrected to false before the section can pass gate_10a traceability requirements.
